measurements.two_hit_interpretation: 4 is first unprimed notification sample; cause not isolated; stationary control gap9 agrees with RepeatFrame9, not a universal latency bound.

limits: Native confirmed52 and49.2;30HP minimum is RomFS only, not a native hit result.
A farthest observed hit and nearest miss do not prove deterministic effective range; angle/body/parallax and dispersion vary.
Scatter evidence is camera-to-native-vector residual; pure intrinsic spread distribution is not isolated.
3.24u/f high samples persist in a rest fixture; player motion inheritance is a supported hypothesis, not an isolated cause.
Bullet velocity getter is statically verified;110/11c position and1238 phase meanings remain candidate fields.
Initial samples can miss birth/early phases at4f stride; network receive gap is not bullet age.
Two rooms reached normal180s match end while planning additional trials; completed trials retained, missing trials not counted.
Sparse overrides, not all native defaults.
Range is catalog annotation, not measured guaranteed hit range.
Swerve parameters do not specify a uniform/Gaussian distribution.
SpawnSpeed differs from effective flight speed.
Native .52 setup uses two verified kit accessor overrides, not a persistent save write; 52HP hit provides independent behavioral evidence.
Position/camera/ink are periodically sampled; receive present is not native bullet creation or impact time.
Network delivery can coalesce victim HP decrements; observed two-hit gap is not firing cadence.
Center ray excludes ordinary static occlusion only; muzzle ray/swept body collision and spread remain possible miss causes.
A hit/miss fraction is target-hit dispersion, not a recovered angular spread distribution.
No direct native bullet coordinate sensor yet; SpawnSpeed is a parameter, not a measured effective speed.

bullet_evidence.name: bullet-r2
limits: Pool object position110/11c semantics are candidate previous/current segment coordinates, not independently established impact coordinates.
Speed is a direct native vector; first 4f sample can miss an early flight phase.
Initial velocity can include player-motion addition; >=2.8 threshold selects early samples, not all bullets.
Yaw/elevation changes include native spread, camera-to-muzzle parallax and body turn. Do not label their combined range as intrinsic spread.
Snapshots alone do not identify bullet age at every first sample or recover the RNG distribution.
